Name: Ancient Trader
Overview:
Ancient Trader is a sea faring trading game in which you sail your ship into unknown waters in search of trade opportunities and compete with other traders to see who can turn the best profit. During the players travels, they will also have to fight off a variety of sea monsters and search for hidden treasures for that little extra money. Fights play out in a turn-based combat screen: every opponent has openly displayed and differently colored cards with varying attack figures; one color also gives an additional attack bonus. Every turn the combatants choose one card and the one with the higher value wins.

Players can also play against up to four other people to see who can accumulate the most wealth and treasure.
